channel_orders.action.accept.explanation: Button on an online order: accept the order for the shop.

channel_orders.action.cancel.explanation: Button on an online order: open the form to cancel the order. The ellipsis means a form opens first.

channel_orders.action.pack.explanation: Button on an online order: record that the order is packed.

channel_orders.action.pick.explanation: Button on an online order: record that the items were picked from the shelves.

channel_orders.action.ship.explanation: Button on an online order: open the form to ship the order with a carrier. The ellipsis means a form opens first.

channel_orders.actions.heading.explanation: Heading of the block of buttons on an online order that accept, pack, ship or cancel it.

channel_orders.blocked.count.explanation: Label in front of the number of actions the cloud refused to take from this till.

channel_orders.blocked.device_credential.explanation: Banner: the till has no credential of its own and must be paired again.

channel_orders.blocked.dismiss_all.explanation: Button that removes all the actions the cloud refused to take, on every order.

channel_orders.blocked.generic.explanation: Banner for any other refusal that blocks the till's actions.

channel_orders.blocked.main_till_require.explanation: Banner: the cloud refused because this till is not the main till.

channel_orders.blocked.store_mismatch.explanation: Banner: the cloud refused because the till is linked to another shop.

channel_orders.cancel.keep.explanation: Button in the cancel form that closes it without cancelling. Deliberately not 'Cancel', which staff would misread.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.explanation: Field label in the cancel form: why the order is cancelled.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.choose.explanation: First, empty option of the cancel reason list. The reason is sent to the online shop, so there is no default.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.customer_re.explanation: Cancel reason: the customer asked for it.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.fraud.explanation: Cancel reason: the order looks fraudulent.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.other.explanation: Cancel reason: none of the others applies.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.out_of_stoc.explanation: Cancel reason: the shop cannot supply the items.

channel_orders.cancel.restock.explanation: Checkbox in the cancel form (ticked by default): the order's items go back into this till's stock when the online shop confirms the cancel.

channel_orders.cancel.submit.explanation: Confirm button of the cancel form (destructive).

channel_orders.cancel.warning.explanation: Warning at the top of the cancel form.

channel_orders.col.channel.explanation: Column heading: the sales channel (web shop or marketplace) the order came from.

channel_orders.col.lines.explanation: Column heading: how many order lines (distinct products) the order has.

channel_orders.col.number.explanation: Column heading: the shop-facing order number such as #1001.

channel_orders.col.placed.explanation: Column heading: when the customer placed the order.

channel_orders.col.status.explanation: Column heading: the order's progress status.

channel_orders.col.total.explanation: Column heading and label: the amount the customer paid for the order.

channel_orders.detail.actions_note.explanation:
Note under an online order: where status actions are taken. my.universaltill.com is a web address; keep it.

Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

channel_orders.detail.back.explanation: Link back to the Online orders list.

channel_orders.detail.col.discount.explanation: Column heading on an online order: the discount the customer got on this line, for all its units together (not per unit). Empty when the line had none.

channel_orders.detail.col.item.explanation: Column heading: product name as sold.

channel_orders.detail.col.price.explanation: Column heading: price of one unit.

channel_orders.detail.col.refunded.explanation: Column heading: units refunded or cancelled so far.

channel_orders.detail.col.restocked.explanation: Column heading: refunded units that went back into stock.

channel_orders.detail.col.sku.explanation: Column heading: stock keeping unit code.

channel_orders.detail.country.explanation: Label: the customer's country. The till stores only the country, never a name or address.

channel_orders.detail.currency_mismatch.explanation: Warning on an order whose currency differs from the shop currency; the currency code follows in brackets.

channel_orders.detail.discount.explanation: Label: discount not tied to a single line.

channel_orders.detail.items_subtotal.explanation: Label in an online order's totals: the lines' quantity x unit price added up, before any discount. Shown only when the order has a discount.

channel_orders.detail.line_discounts.explanation: Label in an online order's totals: the sum of the discounts on its lines. Shown apart from "Order discount", which is a discount not tied to one line.

channel_orders.detail.no_actions_note.explanation: Muted note shown instead of the action buttons on an additional till, for staff without stock rights, or on a till not linked to the cloud.

channel_orders.detail.offline_note.explanation: Muted note under the action buttons: they work offline.

channel_orders.detail.payment.explanation: Label: the payment state the channel reports.

channel_orders.detail.refunded_total.explanation: Label: total amount refunded so far.

channel_orders.detail.shipping.explanation: Label: shipping charged on the order.

channel_orders.detail.tax_added.explanation: Label: tax the channel added on top of tax-exclusive prices.

channel_orders.detail.title.explanation: Heading of one online order; the order number follows it.

channel_orders.detail.total_mismatch.explanation: Warning on an order whose total does not match the sum of its lines; shown as received.

channel_orders.detail.unmatched_line.explanation: Chip on an order line that matches no item in this till, so stock was not changed.

channel_orders.dismiss.explanation: Button that removes a notice about an action's outcome.

channel_orders.empty.explanation: Empty state of the Online orders list.

channel_orders.error.action_not_allowed.explanation: Error above the buttons when the tapped step is no longer possible for the order.

channel_orders.error.actions_not_here.explanation: Error when an action is attempted on a till that is not the main till, or is not linked to the cloud.

channel_orders.error.carrier_invalid.explanation: Field error in the ship form: the carrier is too long or has control characters.

channel_orders.error.carrier_required.explanation: Field error in the ship form: the carrier is empty.

channel_orders.error.load_failed.explanation: Error shown when the Online orders list or an order cannot be read.

channel_orders.error.not_found.explanation: Error shown when an order id is unknown.

channel_orders.error.reason_invalid.explanation: Field error in the cancel form: no reason chosen.

channel_orders.error.save_failed.explanation: Error above the buttons when saving an action on the till failed.

channel_orders.error.tracking_number_inv.explanation: Field error in the ship form: the tracking number has characters the online shops do not take. The characters - . _ / are literal.

channel_orders.error.tracking_url_invali.explanation: Field error in the ship form: the tracking link is not an https:// web address. https:// is literal.

channel_orders.intro.explanation:
Intro line above the Online orders list. Explains these are not till sales. my.universaltill.com is a web address; keep it.

Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

channel_orders.intro_actions.explanation: Intro line above the Online orders list. Explains these are not till sales and that the main till (or my.universaltill.com) can accept, ship or cancel them. my.universaltill.com is a web address; keep it.

channel_orders.note.writeback_skipped.explanation: Notice after a ship or cancel the cloud accepted but the channel cannot receive: staff must repeat it in the channel's own admin.

channel_orders.outcome.accept.explanation: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.outcome.cancel.explanation: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.outcome.pack.explanation: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.outcome.pick.explanation: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.outcome.ship.explanation: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.payment.authorized.explanation: Payment state reported by the channel: authorised, not yet captured.

channel_orders.payment.paid.explanation: Payment state reported by the channel: paid.

channel_orders.payment.partially_refunde.explanation: Payment state reported by the channel: part of the payment was refunded.

channel_orders.payment.pending.explanation: Payment state reported by the channel: not paid yet.

channel_orders.payment.refunded.explanation: Payment state reported by the channel: the payment was refunded.

channel_orders.payment.voided.explanation: Payment state reported by the channel: the payment was voided.

channel_orders.pending.hint.explanation: Muted line under the chips of actions waiting to be sent.

channel_orders.pending_short.accept.explanation: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.cancel.explanation: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.pack.explanation: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.pick.explanation: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.ship.explanation: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.queued.tracking_number.explanation: Label next to the tracking number of a queued ship action (read-only, no 'optional').

channel_orders.queued.tracking_url.explanation: Label next to the tracking link of a queued ship action (read-only, shown as text, no 'optional').

channel_orders.refused.already_shipped.explanation: Refusal reason: cancel or ship after the order shipped.

channel_orders.refused.connection_revoke.explanation: Refusal reason: the channel connection was removed. my.universaltill.com is a web address; keep it.

channel_orders.refused.generic.explanation: Refusal reason for any reason code this till does not know.

channel_orders.refused.invalid_action.explanation: Refusal reason: the shipment or cancel details broke a rule.

channel_orders.refused.invalid_transitio.explanation: Refusal reason: picking, packing or shipping before accepting.

channel_orders.refused.order_cancelled.explanation: Refusal reason: the order is already cancelled.

channel_orders.refused.order_changed.explanation: Refusal reason: the order's content changed before the cancel reached the shop.

channel_orders.refused.order_refunded.explanation: Refusal reason: the order is already refunded.

channel_orders.refused.plan_required.explanation: Refusal reason: the subscription plan does not cover this sales channel.

channel_orders.refused.stale.explanation: Refusal reason: the action was queued for more than 30 days.

channel_orders.refused.title.explanation: Start of the notice about a refused action; followed by the action's name and the reason.

channel_orders.refused.unknown_order.explanation: Refusal reason: the order id is unknown to the cloud.

channel_orders.refused_short.explanation: Short chip in the Online orders list: the online shop refused an action on this order and the refusal has not been dismissed. Sits in a chip that does not wrap.

channel_orders.ship.carrier.explanation: Field label in the ship form: the delivery company, typed by staff (for example a postal service).

channel_orders.ship.submit.explanation: Confirm button of the ship form.

channel_orders.ship.tracking_number.explanation: Field label in the ship form: the carrier's parcel tracking number. May be left empty.

channel_orders.ship.tracking_url.explanation: Field label in the ship form: a web link (https://...) where the customer can follow the parcel. May be left empty.

channel_orders.status.accepted.explanation: Order status: accepted by the shop.

channel_orders.status.new.explanation: Order status: placed, not yet accepted.

channel_orders.status.packed.explanation: Order status: items packed for dispatch.

channel_orders.status.partially_refunded.explanation: Order status: part of the order was refunded.

channel_orders.status.picked.explanation: Order status: items picked from the shelves.

channel_orders.status.shipped.explanation: Order status: handed to the carrier.

channel_orders.title.explanation: The page and menu title for orders taken on a web shop or marketplace and recorded on this till.

kitchenstations.deactivate_confirm.explanation: Confirmation shown before a station is deactivated from its dialog; says orders stop and station-only routes fall back to the default kitchen printer.

kitchenstations.discover.used.explanation: Confirmation shown under Find printers after the operator taps Use this address on a discovered printer; the address field is filled but not yet saved.

kitchenstations.edit.explanation: Title of the Kitchen stations record dialog when an existing station is opened for editing.

kitchenstations.empty.explanation: Empty state on the Kitchen stations page when no station exists yet; points at the + button and says where tickets go meanwhile.

kitchenstations.joined.dialog_hint.explanation: Note at the top of the station dialog on a joined till, explaining the read-only Name and Destination.

kitchenstations.joined.hint.explanation: Page-level note shown under the Kitchen stations header on a joined till, explaining why New is disabled.

kitchenstations.new.submit.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

kitchenstations.none.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

kitchenstations.search_placeholder.explanation: Label and placeholder of the search field above the Kitchen stations list (filters rows by name, destination or printer address).

tables.qr.needs_cloud.explanation: Table QR dialog: plan allows it but the till isn't registered with the cloud.

tables.qr.needs_plan.explanation: Table QR dialog: shown instead of the code when the shop's plan lacks table ordering by phone.

tables.qr.no_cloud_address.explanation: Table QR dialog: the configured cloud endpoint is empty or unusable.

tables.qr.reprint_hint.explanation: Table QR dialog, under the code: older printed table codes (LAN links) stop working; reprint.

tables.qr.table_disabled.explanation: Table QR dialog: the table is deactivated, so no code is shown.
